scenarios.name: normal_operation
scenarios.description: 正常 Function App 操作场景：创建应用服务计划 → 创建函数应用 → 触发部署 → 删除
commands: az functionapp plan create --name test-plan --resource-group test-rg --location eastus --sku B1
az functionapp create --name test-function --resource-group test-rg --plan test-plan --storage-account teststorage
az functionapp deployment source config-zip --name test-function --resource-group test-rg --src app.zip

scenarios.name: partial_failure
scenarios.description: 部分失败场景：函数应用创建成功但部署失败
commands: az functionapp plan create --name fail-plan --resource-group test-rg --location eastus --sku S1
az functionapp create --name fail-function --resource-group test-rg --plan fail-plan --storage-account failstorage
az functionapp deployment source config-zip --name fail-function --resource-group test-rg --src nonexistent.zip

scenarios.name: full_failure
scenarios.description: 完全失败场景：函数应用不存在
